summary.headline: Senores Q2 FY27 revenue rose 25% YoY to INR192 crores and EBITDA 38% to INR58 crores (30% margin), with FY27 guidance of 30-40% revenue growth reiterated.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 was INR192 crores (+25% YoY), the highest quarterly revenue to date, with EBITDA of INR58 crores (+38%, 30% margin, up 290 bps) and PAT of about INR36.6 crores (+22%). H1 FY27 revenue reached INR372.5 crores (+30%), EBITDA INR111 crores (+58%) and PAT INR67 crores (+31%). Management said Zoraya and Amerisyn had no revenue yet but carried setup and operating costs of about INR4 crores in Q2, and both were expected to start contributing in H2 FY27. The company reiterated FY27 guidance of 30-40% revenue growth and 50-60% PAT growth, and guided to around 25% annual growth over the next 2-3 years.

segments.name: Regulated markets
segments.commentary: Revenue grew 28% YoY in Q2 and 34% in H1 FY27. ANDA portfolio rose from 34 (Sep 2025) to 64 (Sep 2026), of which 23 are commercialised. Q2 saw one new ANDA approval (controlled substance) and three sANDA approvals; CDMO/CMO made up about 35% of regulated market revenue.

segments.name: Emerging markets
segments.commentary: Revenue grew about 21% YoY in Q2 and 25% in H1 FY27. Q2 margin dipped to about 4% on large beta-lactam orders; H1 margin about 10%. Management guides mid-to-low teens for full FY27 and says October was strong. The business is cash positive. About 558 registrations approved and about 944 filed.

segments.name: India branded generics
segments.commentary: Gross margin improved to more than 60% this year from 18-20% last year on similar scale, as the company shifts from volume to margin. Management expects INR50-60 crores of revenue this year at a similar gross margin.

segments.name: Apnar (US FDA-approved plant, acquired)
segments.commentary: Management said Apnar would contribute about INR100 crores or more in FY27. Q2 Apnar revenue was about INR21 crores per CFO, though an analyst cited INR31 crores; the transcript leaves this unresolved. Current revenue is mainly from five acquired ANDAs.

segments.name: Others (API, services, government incentives)
segments.commentary: Segment revenue of INR7.8 crores in Q2, mainly API with some service income and government incentives.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance maintained: revenue growth of 30-40% and PAT growth of 50-60%. Management said H1 EBITDA growth of 58% already supports this.
Management expects H2 to be heavier than H1, with H1 about 45% of full-year revenue, as in FY26. Apnar, Zoraya, Amerisyn and new launches are expected to drive H2.
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 30% or higher (CFO: aiming at 30%-plus; chairman: not lower than 30%). Emerging markets margin guided at mid-to-low teens for FY27.
Beyond FY27, annual growth of about 25% (25-30%) is expected over the next 2-3 years, with room for more aggressive growth.
Apnar expected to reach full-scale operations and further expansion over the next 12-18 months. Four commercial lines targeted by March 31, 2027 (about 1.2 billion units capacity).
capex_capacity: Apnar: two commercial lines operating, a third being installed, and a fourth to be completed by March 2027. Total capacity about 1.2 billion units. Utilisation 90-100%, but more than 50% of the capacity is used for validation of launches.
Pre-filled syringe line installed to support GLP-1 and other products. The device is outsourced, while drug substance and drug product are made in-house.
H1 FY27 capex about INR46 crores.
Heavy investment in AI applications and SAP HANA digitisation.
demand_pricing: Controlled substance ANDA approval in Q2 is awaiting DEA quota (45-50 days), with launch expected by end-November 2026. Management expects four to five controlled substance launches before March 2027.

Q2 saw three sANDAs commercialised covering four strengths. Two strengths were first-to-market in the US for a molecule with over $1 billion in US revenue. The other two strengths were second-to-market in niche products.
Propranolol ANDA approved in late October 2026, to be commercialised in Q3. Management expects 3-4 new ANDA approvals and 12-15 sANDA approvals in Q3 FY27.

Amerisyn expected to start business within about 10-15 days of the call. Zoraya expected within about 45 days. Management said 14 ANDAs are planned to launch under Zoraya in FY27, and more than 10 products under Amerisyn within two quarters.
Emerging-market GLP-1 products are in commercialisation in 18-20 markets (Middle East, Africa, LatAm, Far East, CIS), with a wider peptide portfolio.
Q2 emerging-market margin dip was attributed to beta-lactam orders, which carry higher prices but a competitive landscape.

qa_highlights.question: Why was there no new ANDA launch in Q2, and how many ANDAs can be commercialised per quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: The Q2 approval was for a controlled substance, which needs DEA quota (45-50 days) before launch. Non-ANDA-approval time lags of 3-12 months apply to acquired ANDAs. Management said 41 of 64 approved ANDAs are not yet commercialised, to be launched over six to eight quarters, and gave no quarterly figure.

qa_highlights.question: What were the Zoraya and Amerisyn costs in Q2, and can FY27 EBITDA margin stay at 28-30%?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR4 crores of costs were incurred with no revenue, and the CFO put the floor at INR2-2.5 crores. Management said the costs would be absorbed as revenue ramps. Management said FY27 margin would be 30% or more, not 28%.

qa_highlights.question: How is the Amerisyn and Zoraya JV structured, and where does inventory sit?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said more than 90% of Amerisyn products are made at the company's US facility. Zoraya is similar. Both are wholly owned subsidiaries, so inventory sits on the company's books, and inventory build-up is tightly controlled.

qa_highlights.question: How will the 50-60% PAT growth guidance be achieved given higher costs from the new subsidiaries?
qa_highlights.answer: H2 is expected to be heavier, with Ratnatris, new launches at Aavis and Havix, and Amerisyn contributing to profit. The chairman said bottom-line growth should exceed top-line growth, and about 50% PAT growth is the internal estimate.

qa_highlights.question: Why was the growth outlook cut to 20-25% from the earlier 30-40%, and is it caution?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the approved ANDA count rose from 58 to 64 and the pipeline is strong. The chairman said the company has guided about 25-30% growth to be maintained beyond FY27 and is confident of more aggressive growth.

qa_highlights.question: Why did emerging market margins fall to about 4% in Q2, and will they recover?
qa_highlights.answer: The dip was due to large beta-lactam orders with competitive pricing. Management expects recovery to the mid-to-late teens, with full-year margin in mid-to-low teens. H1 margin was about 10%, and October was strong.

qa_highlights.question: Why did unbilled revenue (other financial assets) rise, and what share is over one year old?
qa_highlights.answer: The rise is from big sANDA launches billed and shipped in September, not yet sold through by distributors. Under 10%, about 8-9% of the total, is overdue for more than one year.

risks_watch: Apnar utilisation is near capacity, but more than 50% is used for validation. Revenue is ramping slowly, and the Apnar FDA inspection produced one minor 483 observation.
Zoraya and Amerisyn had no revenue in Q2 and cost INR4 crores. Their revenue ramp and margin dilution are unproven, and management gave no revenue numbers yet.
Margin guidance is directional only. Management said quarterly margins will vary with product mix, and it gave no firm steady-state number beyond FY27.
Launch timing risk: ANDA-to-launch lags of 3-12 months, DEA quota for controlled substances, and 41 of 64 approved ANDAs not yet commercialised.
Q2 emerging-market margin of about 4% versus the 18-20% target voiced on the prior call; recovery to mid-teens is needed in H2.
Apnar revenue figure discrepancy: the CFO cited INR21 crores, while the analyst cited INR31 crores. Clarify in the next filing.
Unbilled revenue increase, with 8-9% over one year old, needs monitoring against receivable days.
summary.management_tone: Confident and forward-looking on launches, Apnar and the subsidiaries, and reiterated FY27 guidance. Evasive on quantifying the revenue and margin contribution from Zoraya and Amerisyn, and on quarterly margin, which management said would vary. Management repeatedly referred to "direction" rather than numbers.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management guided FY27 EBITDA margin at 30% or higher (not lower than 30%) against H1 margin of almost 30%, with Q2 at 30% up 290 bps YoY, though Zoraya and Amerisyn carry about INR4 crores of Q2 setup cost and emerging-market margin is guided at mid-to-low teens.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Apnar's fourth commercial line is due by March 31, 2027 taking capacity to about 1.2 billion units, and Apnar utilisation is 90-100% though over 50% of capacity goes to launch validation; Zoraya and Amerisyn start within about 45 days and 10-15 days respectively.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: FY27 revenue growth guided at 30-40% with H1 revenue up 30% to INR372.5 crores, and H2 expected heavier (H1 about 45% of full year) on Apnar, Zoraya, Amerisyn, 4-5 controlled-substance launches and 12-15 sANDA approvals in Q3.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Utilisation is 90-100% at Apnar and H1 capex was about INR46 crores, but no new capex amount or plant was announced and the fourth line is already in progress.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 revenue (30-40%) and PAT (50-60%) growth guidance was only held, not raised, and management said H2 is heavier with several unproven contributors (Zoraya, Amerisyn, Apnar revenue unresolved at INR21 vs 31 crores).

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Emerging-market margin was cut to mid-to-low teens for FY27 after Q2 fell to about 4%, and Zoraya/Amerisyn costs (about INR4 crores in Q2, floor INR2-2.5 crores) with no revenue yet could pressure H2 PAT growth.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Propranolol ANDA approved in late October 2026 for Q3 commercialisation, controlled-substance launch expected by end-November 2026, and management expects 3-4 new ANDA and 12-15 sANDA approvals in Q3 FY27.

rows.label: 41 of 64 approved ANDAs not yet commercialised
rows.why: 41 of 64 approved ANDAs remain uncommercialised and management expects them launched over six to eight quarters, giving a steady launch pipeline, though 3-12 month lags and DEA quota add timing risk.

rows.label: GLP-1 emerging-market commercialisation
rows.why: Emerging-market GLP-1 products are already in commercialisation in 18-20 markets with 558 registrations approved and 944 filed, and a pre-filled syringe line is commissioned for GLP-1 products.

rows.label: India branded generics margin shift
rows.why: Gross margin rose to more than 60% from 18-20% last year on similar scale, with INR50-60 crores revenue guided this year at a similar gross margin.
